Rajasthan Safai Karamchari Online Form 2026 (24752 Posts) – Full Details

Rajasthan Local Self Government Department has released a notification for the recruitment of Safai Karamchari (Sweeper) posts on its official Website. This recruitment has been announced for a total of 24,752 posts. The online application process for Rajasthan Safai Karamchari Recruitment 2026 has started from 15 August 2026, and candidates can apply until 28 September 2026. Candidates are advised to check the complete details for Rajasthan Safai Karamchari Recruitment 2026 given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 27 July 2026
  • Application Start : 15 August 2026
  • Last Date for Apply: 28 September 2026
  • Last Date Fee Payment : 28 September 2026
  • Admit Card : Notify Later

Application Fee

  • General / Other State : Rs. 600/-
  • OBC / BC / SC / ST : Rs. 400/-
  • Correction Charge : Rs. 100/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
